XIII. WORKMANS COMPENSATION ACT: (IN CASE OF INSTALLATION & COMMISSIONING ONLY) THE CONTRA CTOR SHALL AT ALL TIMES INDEMNIFY THE PURCHASER AGAINST ANY CLAI M WHCH MAY BE MADE UNDER THE WORKMAN'S COMPENSATION ACT 1923 OR ANY ST ATUTORY MODIFICATIONS THEREOF OR OTHERWI SE FOR IN RESPECT OF ANY DAMAGE OR INJURY ETC. SUSTAINED BY ANY WORKER OR PERSON IN THE EMP LOYMENT OF THE CONTRACTOR. XIV. Acceptance Criteria: A. The equipment shall be supplied with all accessories, cables, controller, software, and docu mentation as specified in the purchase order. B. The mass analyser shall achieve the specified mass range and mass resolution as provided i n the specification. The Supplier to demonstrate in our place. C. The system shall successfully detect and distinguish ³He (m/z = 3) and ⁴He (m/z = 4) under t he specified operating conditions. D. The instrument shall demonstrate stable peak positions and repeatable signal intensities d uring repeated measurements. E. The instrument shall communicate properly with the control software, and all operating par ameters (mass scan, detector settings, data acquisition, and data export) shall function correctly. F. The detector shall meet the specified sensitivity and noise performance. G. The complete system shall operate continuously for a minimum of 4–8 hours without abnor mal drift, communication errors, or hardware faults. H. The supplier shall provide installation, commissioning, operational demonstration, and user training. I. The manufacturer shall provide factory calibration certificates, test reports, user manuals, a nd warranty documentation. J. Certificate of Conformance (COC) is to be provided from the OEM of the mass analyzer syste m. K. Offers will be considered only from original manufacturer or a valid authorized agent of an original manufacturer. Valid authorization certificate from OEM should be submitted along wit h the offer in case the bidder is authorized distributor/agent. L. All the items should be supplied by the single vendor. . 7.
